title: Management, Resume & National Board Examination
description: This course provides an overview of leadership and management styles and effective communication skills in the workplace. Current healthcare economics, employment outlook, and interviewing skills are also covered. Preparation for the National Board for Respiratory Care Examination, including content outlines, self-evaluation, the application process, and mock examinations. Intended for students in the Respiratory Therapy Program; enrollment is limited to students accepted in the program.
outcomes: Create a Resume and a Cover Letter.
Passes the program final with a minimum score of 70%
objectives: Differentiate between the different management and leadership styles.
Describe current healthcare employment opportunities across the respiratory therapy profession.
Demonstrate the necessary skills for obtaining an employment interview.
Conduct self-evaluations to identify areas of deficiency in preparation for the written Board exam and clinical simulation examinations.
content: National Board for Respiratory Care examination matrix
National Board for Respiratory Care clinical simulation
Identify content that needs to be reviewed in order to successfully pass the Board exams
